description: Developer tooling caches and build output. Project folders themselves are never suggested, only their regenerable parts.

rules.name: Xcode build data (DerivedData)
rules.reason: Intermediate build products and indexes for Xcode projects.
rules.regenerates: Xcode rebuilds it on the next build.

rules.name: Xcode device support files
rules.reason: Debug symbols copied from each iOS version you've connected a device with. Old versions are rarely needed.
rules.regenerates: Copied again when you connect a device running that version.

rules.name: Xcode archives
rules.reason: Builds you archived for distribution. Keep ones whose crash logs you may still need to symbolicate.

rules.name: iOS Simulator devices
rules.reason: Simulator devices, including ones for runtimes you no longer have.
rules.advice: Run `xcrun simctl delete unavailable` to remove dead simulators safely.

rules.name: Package manager download cache
rules.reason: Copies of packages already downloaded once, kept to speed up future installs.
rules.regenerates: Packages are downloaded again on the next install that needs them.

rules.name: Package store / dependency cache
rules.reason: Shared store of downloaded dependencies. Projects re-fetch what they need.
rules.regenerates: Re-downloaded on the next build/install (can take a while on slow connections).

rules.name: VS Code extension caches
rules.reason: IntelliSense databases and downloaded extension installers.
rules.regenerates: Rebuilt when you open a project in VS Code.
